title: verbena alatocarpa
intro: Verbena alatocarpa, commonly known as the 'Red Verbena', is a plant species native to Mexico and Central America. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing stress and anxiety due to its calming effects, and it also has anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties that contribute to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Verbena alatocarpa include its ability to act as an anti-anxiety agent, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties, which can aid in the treatment of various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Verbena alatocarpa include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and health benefits.
